svg.title: Chapter IV · DRAGONFIRE
svg.desc: Comic panel, chapter IV · DRAGONFIRE. Pixel art: a dragon with red wings breathing a jet of fire over dark mountains at dusk, framed by AR viewfinder corners. AR game for Duolingo's 10-year campaign, played at a campus event. Scan posters, catch Lingos. Stack: React, TypeScript, MindAR, Firebase.
